meta.title: EasyClub — the future of restaurants and nightclubs
meta.description: Point of sale, reservations, stock, staff rota and reports in one iPad app, run by voice with Easy, an AI agent. Free, no subscription. Born in Monaco, made for the world.

hero.lead: Point of sale, reservations, stock, staff rota and reports in one iPad app, that you run by voice with Easy.
hero.videoLabel: By voice, Easy is asked to close the register: it compares the cash counted with the cash expected and waits for confirmation.

free.lead: A till here, booking software there, a spreadsheet for stock, an app for the rota, another for loyalty: that many subscriptions to pay every month, and none of them talk to each other.
free.notLinked: None of them talk to each other
free.cardText: The sixteen apps and Easy, the AI agent, in a single app. Connected to each other, always up to date.
free.future: This is the future of restaurants and nightclubs: one system, connected end to end, that you run by voice. And it’s free.

easy.eyebrow: Easy · the AI agent, by voice
easy.lead: No keyboard, no menus to dig through: you talk to the iPad. Easy closes the register, pulls the weekly report, builds the rota and prepares supplier orders, on the same screens as your team.

demos.said: Close the register, I counted €396.50 in cash.
demos.result: Easy counts, finds the gap and the tables still open, then waits for your go-ahead: a close is sealed and can’t be undone.
Revenue, tickets, average ticket, comparison with the week before, best night, best sellers: in one sentence.

demos.said: Build the rota for the week of 9 November.
demos.result: Twenty-three shifts set for the whole team, as a draft: all that’s left is to publish it.

voice.title: Everything runs by voice
voice.text: Press, speak. Easy knows your menu, your tables, your stock and your team.

rights.title: The rights of whoever is signed in
rights.text: A waiter can’t do what a manager does. Neither can Easy.

confirm.title: Your go-ahead first
confirm.text: Anything sensitive, like closing the register, always waits for a tap on screen.

easy.tryHint: Tap a sentence to hear it in action

commands.q: Close the register, I counted €396.50 in cash
commands.a: Cash is €2.00 short, and six tables are still open. Close anyway?
€36,945.70 over 206 tickets, average ticket €179.64 (+4.7%). Best night: Friday, €6,545.60.
Rota for 10 to 15 November ready: 23 shifts for 6 people. Shall I publish it?

commands.q: Order what we’re missing from Caves du Rocher
steps: Purchase order created, as a draft
commands.a: Purchase order ready for Caves du Rocher: brut champagne, Dom Pérignon, Veuve Clicquot and Chablis. Shall I send it?

commands.q: Book 8 for Saturday at 10 pm, name Morel
commands.a: Booked: Morel, 8 guests, Saturday at 22:00, table T11.

commands.q: Who sold the most this week?
commands.a: Théo: €12,242.25 over 62 tickets, ahead of Lucas and Inès.

connected.lead: What happens in one app lands in all the others at once, on every iPad in the room. No double entry, no exports, no numbers that don’t add up.

reservations.title: Every booking finds its table.
reservations.lead: Tonight’s bookings, the waiting list and the floor plan in one place. The guest arrives: one gesture, they’re seated, and their table opens in their name.
points: Birthdays, allergies and requests visible to the whole team
Waiting list, with covers and arrival time
By voice: “8 people Saturday at 10 pm, name Morel”

stock.title: Stock counts itself.
stock.lead: Every sale depletes its ingredients through recipes. When an item drops below its threshold, the alert goes out, and the supplier order is ready.
points: Recipes with automatic depletion on every sale
Supplier purchase orders, prepared by Easy
stock.recipe: Recipe: 3 cl gin, 3 cl Campari, 3 cl vermouth
stock.alert: Campari below its threshold: added to the Caves du Rocher order

tour.title: One app. The whole room.
tour.lead: Everything a service needs, on the iPad already in your hand.

steps.title: The bar in three taps.
steps.text: Big tiles, categories, a crystal-clear ticket. Card, cash or mobile, tips included, receipt by e-mail, text or QR code.

steps.title: A floor plan that’s alive.
steps.text: Dining room, terrace and bar at a glance: covers, rounds sent to the bar or kitchen, split bills.

steps.title: The register, to the cent.
steps.text: The current service, payment methods, VAT, sales per server. Every sale is sealed in a fiscal journal; the close is done by voice.

steps.title: Numbers during service.
steps.text: Revenue, tickets, average ticket, payment methods. Not the next morning: right now.

steps.title: Next week’s rota, dictated.
steps.text: Shifts, time clock, breaks, tips. Easy builds the week, you publish it, the team sees it.

night.title: Made for the room, not the back office.

sync.title: Every iPad, live.
sync.text: Bar, floor and door see the same tables and the same orders the moment they change.

offline.title: Wi-Fi down? Keep going.
offline.text: Sales stay on the iPad and sync as soon as the network is back.

journal.title: A journal that can’t be erased.
journal.text: Every sale is sealed and chained to the one before. Any later change shows.

brand.title: In your colours.
brand.text: Your venue’s name, logo and colour, at launch and on the lock screen.

rights.title: Everyone their rights.
rights.text: Manager, waiter, bartender, host: one code each, and the session locks itself.

native.title: A real iPad app.
native.text: Full screen, always up to date: every improvement arrives without reinstalling.

apps.title: Sixteen apps. No subscription.
apps.lead: Everything is included. Keep the ones your venue needs, tuck the others away. Tap an app to see it.

monaco.lead: EasyClub was born among the bars, clubs and restaurants that never sleep. A first pilot venue is in service in Monte-Carlo.

cta.title: Step into the future. It’s free.
cta.lead: An iPad demo, at your place, while the room gets ready. You speak, Easy does the rest.
